introduce: Tilt your head towards your left shoulder, and hold it for a few seconds. \n\nThen tilt your head towards your right shoulder, and also hold it for a few seconds. Repeat the exercise.
name: SIDE-TO-SIDE TILTS

tips.text: Please don't move your shoulders when tilting your head.
Please do it slowly to feel the stretch.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Sit up nice and tall in the chair. 

Tuck your chin, and round your back as you exhale. Then take a breath in, and look up, trying to drive your chest out. 

Repeat the exercise.
name: CHAIR CAT COW

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Keep your feet flat on the floor.
Inhale when you drive your chest out, and exhale when you round your back.
You should not feel tenseness in your shoulders or back.
This exercise works on your upper back and helps stretch your spine.

introduce: Sit upright with your back straight and feet flat on the floor. Bend your knees at 90 degrees with your feet hip-width apart. Put your hands beside your ears.\n\nRotate your body gently and slowly. This stretches your back and hips.
name: CHAIR TORSO TWIST

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Please rotate your body gently and slowly.
Your toes and knees should always face forward.
Make sure your abs muscles are engaged.
Please relax your shoulders.
This exercise stretches your back and hips.

introduce: Sit upright with your feet flat on the floor. Keep your back straight and your hands behind your ears.\n\nBend at your waist and squeeze obliques to one side as far as possible. Hold for a count, and return to the starting position. Switch to the other side and repeat.
name: CHAIR SIDE BEND

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.
Exhale as you bend to the side, and inhale as you return.
You can feel your obliques and lower back stretched.

introduce:
Sit on a chair with your legs hip-with apart and your feet flat on the floor.

Take a deep breath and as you exhale, slowly curl your chin to your chest, draw your lower belly in and round your back. 

Fold your body and press your entire palms on the floor. With every exhalation, move your chest and shoulders away from your thighs. Hold this position for a few breaths.
name: CHAIR CHILD'S POSE

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Engage your core muscles.
Breathe in deeply and breathe out completely.
This pose helps to release tightness in your neck, shoulders, lower back, and hips.
